terms.meaning: cumulative grade point average, the overall score across all graded courses
a grading system where the best possible grade is 10
a ready-made button with a common value the owner can click instead of typing

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads React hooks, icons and the store that the pop-up needs.
sections.why: Required so the pop-up can read and save the goal.

sections.name: CgpaGoalModalProps
sections.title: Pop-up inputs
sections.what: Defines the parent's inputs: whether the pop-up is open and how to close it.
sections.why: Lets the parent control when the pop-up appears.

sections.name: CgpaGoalModal (part 1)
sections.title: Loading the saved goal
sections.what: Reads the saved goal from the store, and fills the field with it, formatted to two decimal places, when the pop-up opens. Otherwise it clears the field.
sections.why: Lets the owner see and edit the current goal.

sections.name: CgpaGoalModal (part 2)
sections.title: Save and presets
sections.what: On submit, accepts the value only if it is a number from 0 to 10, then saves it and closes. Preset buttons fill the field with 8.0, 8.5, 9.0 or 9.5.
sections.why: Keeps invalid goals out of the store and makes common targets quick to pick.
sections.watch_out: A rejected value gives no message, so the owner may think the save failed silently.

summary: A small pop-up where the owner types a target CGPA between 0 and 10 and saves it to the store.
purpose: Lets the owner set a goal grade point average on the 10-point Indian scale.
why: Gives the dashboard a target to compare the real CGPA against.
how: When opened, the field fills with the saved goal if one exists. The owner types or picks a quick preset. On save, the value is read as a number and is stored only if it is between 0 and 10. Then the pop-up closes.
inputs: Whether the pop-up is open, a function to close it, the saved goal from the store, and the owner's typed value or preset choice.
outputs: Stores the new goal through the store's goal action and closes the pop-up.
risks: If the value is outside 0 to 10 or not a number, the save silently does nothing and the pop-up stays open with no message.
debug: If saving does nothing, check the typed value is a number from 0 to 10. If the field shows a wrong starting value, check the saved goal in the store.
